name: wsdyn-auroc-midrank
symptom: auroc() in wsdyn gives wrong AUROC values, for example a perfect ranking no longer scores 1.0.

name: wsdyn-cf7-gate
symptom: validate_cf7_label() rejects rows whose effect is exactly 15 percent as dead-zone rows, but 15 percent should count as False.

name: wsdyn-accuracy-threshold
symptom: metrics() reports the wrong accuracy when a predicted probability is exactly 0.5.

name: wsdyn-duplicate-claims
symptom: index_rows() silently accepts duplicate claim_id values instead of raising ValueError.

name: wsdyn-blind-metadata
symptom: blind_claim() lets extra metadata nested inside messages through to the blinded output.

name: wsdyn-bootstrap-floor
symptom: paired_analysis() accepts fewer than 100 bootstrap draws instead of raising ValueError.
